chunks: Regarding salat (prayer) in a carriage (mahmil): "Pray sitting cross-legged, with the legs extended, and in whatever way is possible for you."

key_terms.أَمْكَنَكَ: what is within your ability or capacity
key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the ritual act being discussed
key_terms.الْمَحْمِلِ: a carriage or riding conveyance in which prayer is being performed

ai.seo_question: How should salat (prayer) be performed in a mahmil or carriage when normal posture is not possible?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for performing salat (prayer) in a mahmil when normal posture may be difficult. It indicates flexibility in bodily positioning and establishes that one should pray in whatever manner one is able.
